intro.greeting: I'm Riley, and I like taking things apart to see how they work.
intro.summary: I started out writing firmware for engine displays and ended up running product for lending platforms. The jobs look different on paper. The habit is the same: find out where people get stuck, then fix that first.

section.title: My Approach
section.p: I start with what customers are already telling us. Funnel reports, support tickets, session replays. Most weeks the answer is sitting in one of them.
Then I do the math myself. If a change touches how a loan is priced or paid, I'll model it in a spreadsheet until engineering has something concrete to build from.
When risk or finance pushes back, I restate the objection in their terms and go find the number that answers it.

section.title: Beyond Work
section.p: I live in a small lake town with my partner and a dog who has opinions about the mail carrier.
Outside work I tinker: home automation, an old sailboat that always needs something, and whatever side project I've talked myself into this month.
